sources.title: Official Portal of the Kingdom of Morocco

capital.evidence_quote: Rabat is the administrative capital of the Kingdom of Morocco

currency.evidence_quote: The Moroccan Dirham (MAD) is the official legal tender in Morocco

timezone.evidence_quote: Morocco permanently observes Western European Summer Time UTC+1 with temporary rollback during Ramadan

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across the Moroccan national grid is 220V single-phase

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Standard electrical operating frequency in Morocco is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Electrical outlets in Morocco conform to European Type C and Type E specifications

sources.title: Direction Generale de la Surete Nationale (DGSN)

police.evidence_quote: Emergency national police assistance in Moroccan urban areas is reachable via 19

ambulance.evidence_quote: Ambulance and civil protection emergency hotline in Morocco is 15

fire.evidence_quote: Fire emergency services are operated directly under civil protection dispatch number 15

sources.title: Agence Nationale de Reglementation des Telecommunications

general.evidence_quote: Standard European emergency number 112 is routed on mobile networks across Morocco

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Brigade Touristique operates through central police dispatch 19 and local medina posts

regional_warnings.reason: Presence of unexploded ordnance and restricted military operations

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Morocco average mobile download speed is 38.4 Mbps nationwide

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Fixed broadband speed in Morocco averages 24.1 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: eSIM is supported by international providers and local carriers. Tourist physical SIMs are widely available at airports from Maroc Telecom, Orange, and Inwi with passport registration.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid SIM registration requires valid passport identification in accordance with ANRT rules

religion.evidence_quote: Islam is the official state religion of the Kingdom of Morocco

festivals.value: Ramazan, Kurban Bayramı (Aid al-Adha), Taht Bayramı (Fete du Trone, 30 Temmuz), Fas Bağımsızlık Günü (18 Kasım)
festivals.evidence_quote: Throne Day on July 30 and major Islamic occasions represent Morocco's primary national holidays

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Kraliyet ve monarşiye saygısızlık kesinlikle yasa dışıdır. Camiilere gayrimüslim girişi sadece Kazablanka II. Hasan Camii'nde rehberli turlarla serbesttir. Dron sokulması izne tabidir; izinsiz el konulur.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Non-Muslims are not permitted entry to mosques in Morocco, with the notable exception of Hassan II Mosque

tipping.value: Restoranlarda %10 civarı bahşiş yaygındır. Küçük kafelerde hesabı yukarı yuvarlamak ve otopark bekçilerine (gardien) 2-5 MAD vermek adettendir.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping roughly 10% in restaurants and leaving small coins for parking attendants is customary
